evidence: The crystallographic orientation of the ZnO:Al films was determined by an X-ray diffraction (XRD) with CuK radiation, and the morphologies of the films were observed using a scanning electron microscope (SEM) and an atomic force microscope (AFM). UV-vis spectra were taken using a Hitachi U-3501 spectrophotometer. The surface work function of the ZnO:Al films and ITO film was measured using a photoelectron spectrometer surface analyzer (RIKEN AC-2). The sheet resistance was measured by means of the four-point probe method with the film thickness of 200 nm.
